channel.title: Anthropic News
channel.description: The latest news, announcements, partnerships, and research updates from Anthropic.

item.title: Claude is a space to think
item.description: Anthropic announces Claude will remain ad-free, explaining why advertising incentives are incompatible with a genuinely helpful AI assistant.

item.title: Apple's Xcode now supports the Claude Agent SDK
item.description: Apple's Xcode integrates the Claude Agent SDK, enabling developers to build AI-powered applications within Apple's development ecosystem.

item.title: Anthropic partners with Allen Institute and Howard Hughes Medical Institute to accelerate scientific discovery
item.description: Anthropic partners with leading research institutions to apply Claude to accelerate breakthroughs in biological and biomedical sciences.

item.title: Claude on Mars
item.description: The first AI-assisted drive on another planet. Claude helped NASA's Perseverance rover travel four hundred meters on Mars.

item.title: ServiceNow chooses Claude to power customer apps and increase internal productivity
item.description: ServiceNow selects Claude to enhance customer applications and boost internal productivity across the enterprise platform.

item.title: Anthropic partners with the UK Government to bring AI assistance to GOV.UK services
item.description: Anthropic and the UK Government deploy a Claude-powered AI assistant on GOV.UK to guide citizens through government processes.

item.title: Claude's new constitution
item.description: Anthropic publishes a new version of Claude's constitution, the explicit set of values and principles that guide Claude's behavior through Constitutional AI.

item.title: Anthropic and Teach For All launch global AI training initiative for educators
item.description: Anthropic partners with Teach For All to bring AI literacy and training to educators worldwide, supporting responsible AI adoption in education.

item.title: Anthropic appoints Irina Ghose as Managing Director of India
item.description: Anthropic names Irina Ghose as Managing Director of India ahead of opening its Bengaluru office, expanding operations in the Asia Pacific region.

item.title: How scientists are using Claude to accelerate research and discovery
item.description: Scientists across disciplines use Claude to analyze data, generate hypotheses, and accelerate the pace of research and discovery.

item.title: Accenture and Anthropic launch multi-year partnership
item.description: Initial solutions target regulated industries with approximately 30,000 Accenture professionals trained on Claude for enterprise transformation.

item.title: Snowflake and Anthropic announce $200 million partnership
item.description: A multi-year $200 million agreement to make Claude models available across Snowflake's platform to more than 12,600 global customers.

item.title: Introducing Claude Opus 4.5
item.description: The best model in the world for coding, agents, and computer use, with meaningful improvements to everyday tasks and dramatic token efficiency gains.

item.title: A statement from Dario Amodei on American AI leadership
item.description: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei outlines the company's commitment to advancing America's leadership in building powerful and beneficial AI.

item.title: Introducing Claude Haiku 4.5
item.description: Matches state-of-the-art coding capabilities while delivering unprecedented speed and cost-efficiency for high-throughput applications.

item.title: Anthropic expands global operations to India
item.description: Anthropic announces plans to open an office in Bengaluru, India, its second in Asia Pacific, to serve India's rapidly growing AI ecosystem.

item.title: Introducing Claude Sonnet 4.5
item.description: Sets new benchmark records in coding, reasoning, and computer use while being the most aligned frontier model, released under ASL-3 protections.

item.title: Anthropic Economic Futures Program Launch
item.description: A new initiative to support research and policy development focused on addressing AI's economic impacts and understanding how AI is reshaping work.

item.title: Expanding our model safety bug bounty program
item.description: Anthropic expands its bug bounty program with rewards up to $15,000 for novel universal jailbreak attacks that expose vulnerabilities in critical risk areas.
